confidenceLimiters.text: PROP-DEC-001 and PROP-DEC-004 were both answered with the rationale "Easier for PoC", against a `public-internet` exposure target and `strict` rigor. The choices are individually defensible — JWT is the strongest option not blocked on absent infrastructure — but the stated driver is convenience rather than threat model. `chaos:review` should re-test this.
RK-5: nothing in this repository issues tokens, so the API is not independently usable after this change. Recorded as a non-goal in every artifact rather than resolved.
PROP-DEC-006 waives archaeology on the claim that the source manifest plus the green test baseline are equivalent evidence. Reasonable for ~150 lines across six files, but it is a claim, not a proof.
The `chaos-interaction` MCP tools were unavailable in this session; the documented runtime CLI fallback was used, which caps effective confidence at MEDIUM.

Run `RUN-…-d6b050` was cancelled mid-resume and the command continued under `RUN-…-e2858e` after a session-state fault; see the runtime note in `decision-events.md`. No decision or response artifact was lost.

facts.title: Authenticate and harden the Task Tracker API before public-internet exposure
intent: Close the "API is open to every caller" gap before the Task Tracker API is exposed to the **public internet** (PROP-DEC-002).
Today there is no authentication, no authorization and no edge hardening on any route `[FACT]`.

Scope is **authentication plus edge hardening** (PROP-DEC-001) using **JWT bearer** credentials (PROP-DEC-004), with the **application terminating TLS** (PROP-DEC-005). Token issuance and per-caller authorization are explicit non-goals.

openspec.invocationPath: acceptable path 3 — drove the `openspec` CLI directly (`openspec new change` → `openspec status --json` → `openspec instructions <artifact> --json` per ready artifact → write to each `resolvedOutputPath`).
openspec.confidenceImpact: none from OpenSpec (gate ran cleanly, no degraded mode).

sourceManifest.role: Host/composition. Registers `TaskStore`, JSON enum options, `GET /`, `MapTaskEndpoints()`. **No auth middleware.**
5 CRUD routes under `/tasks`. **No auth metadata on any route.**
5 integration tests via `WebApplicationFactory<Program>` — the baseline every new test extends
Environments = local dev only; no CD target

risk.classRationale: auth/identity is a HIGH/CRITICAL trigger, and PROP-DEC-002 = `public-internet` puts an untrusted caller population in front of it.

items.summary: JWT chosen partly for PoC speed proves inadequate for untrusted callers
items.mitigation: `AddAuthentication` seam repoints at an external IdP by configuration (design D1); ADR records the upgrade path

items.summary: R-008 violated later by registering `UseForwardedHeaders` with an empty trusted set
items.mitigation: Satisfied **by construction** — middleware not registered (PROP-DEC-005/design D2); contract statement + spec scenario assert its absence
Fail-fast startup validation; contract + spec require non-secret `appsettings.json`; task 5.2 checks tracked files

items.summary: Authenticated ≠ authorized — any valid token can mutate any task (`TaskItem` has no owner)
items.mitigation: Explicit non-goal of this change; recorded as a known gap, not an oversight

items.summary: Production still has no token issuer; the dev endpoint does not close this
items.mitigation: Scoped out deliberately (REV-DEC-003); follow-up issuance change recorded

items.summary: **The dev-only issuance endpoint reaches a deployed environment and mints tokens for anyone** — a complete bypass of this entire change
items.mitigation: **Highest residual risk.** Two independent gates (design D7): `IsDevelopment()` **and** an opt-in flag defaulting off; route unmapped rather than guarded; tests 4.7c/4.7d assert absence outside Development. Requires two independent mistakes to expose.

items.summary: Rate-limit state is in-memory and per-instance
items.mitigation: Accepted; architecture already declares scale-out a non-goal

items.summary: The 5 existing integration tests all call `/tasks` unauthenticated and will break
items.mitigation: Expected; tasks 4.1–4.2 update them to authenticate, R-003 keeps the suite green
